proposal_title: Alignment of Handoff Index with Normative Repo Blueprints
domain_specific_rationale: From a platform infrastructure and operational architecture perspective, specification documents must strictly reflect realizable, normative system interfaces rather than unbacked hypothetical components. Previous handoff indices introduced extraneous, unvalidated infrastructure claims—such as a dedicated hardware 'SecretEnclave' module, unvoted gRPC endpoints on browser worker adapters, and non-standard raw WebSocket servers in core state. CP-021 purges all ungrounded claims from AGENT_BUILD_PACKET_INDEX.md and handoff metadata, realigning implementation requirements directly with normative repository blueprints (R01–R15), standard OS environment/Vault secret injection, and published JSON Schema draft-07 contracts.
evidence_citations: 09_agent_packets/AGENT_BUILD_PACKET_INDEX.md:L1-L24 (Unified packet index reflecting normative blueprints R01-R15 without extraneous subsystems)
REMEDIATION_FINDING_REGISTER.md:L223-L234 (TECH-009 root cause analysis and resolution requirements)
03_repo_blueprints/R01_CONTRACTS.md through R15_INTEGRATION_HARNESS.md (Normative interfaces and state boundary definitions)
capability_impact: Protects handoff trustworthiness and eliminates platform architectural drift, ensuring implementation agents build strictly against verified repo blueprints and contracts.
residual_risk: Future implementation teams might attempt to reintroduce ad-hoc transport protocols without architectural review. Mitigated by CI contract conformance test suites rejecting non-standard ports and protocols.
